tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere: the warm cream ground.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the renter's mobile pages: one step up from the page.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table headers, selected rows, grouped info. Use brick-text, not brick, for text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and icons on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, helper copy. 6:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and forest fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and other controls (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and the one main action on a screen.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand block colour: hero bands, the cover, large dark panels. Not for text in dark.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: The brand accent: one emphasis per screen (a key number, the active step, a highlight). Fills and large type only.

tokens.name: brick-text
tokens.usage: Brick for small text and links (5:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Soft accent: labels on forest, illustrations, the cover. Not for text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, verified, passed: check results, signed, paid.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: waiting on a referee, an offer about to expire.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only. Never for a renter who failed a check: use warning and words.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and links inside notices.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Letting a home should be quick

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: the letting's address, the renter's home.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and big numbers (days to let, enquiries).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Thanks for your interest. We'll be in touch by Friday either way.
styles.usage: Default text. Never smaller on renter pages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense operator tables and secondary lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, table headers and status labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes and fine print. Not for anything a renter must act on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items: a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls and table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; the side gutter on renter pages.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and marketing spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only. Everything else uses borders, not shadows.
